# Vaibhav Shrivastava — vaibhav.sh

> Product and engineering leader. (Global) Head of Supplier Fraud at Booking.com, Amsterdam. Building systems that make digital economies trustworthy. Writing about AI for product managers. Working on Agent OS and Trust Debt.

## About

Vaibhav Shrivastava is the (Global) Head of Supplier Fraud at Booking.com, operating at Director level, leading an 80+ person cross-functional organisation across Amsterdam, Bucharest, Bangalore, and the UK. Background: software developer, co-founder and CTO of an acquired fintech startup (Ruplee), technical PM at Xiaomi and CoinTribe, (Global) Head of Supplier Fraud at Booking.com since Aug 2019.

Core focus: platform integrity, applied AI/ML, agentic systems, operator-led product building.

## Projects

Agent OS — open source multi-agent professional operating system
URL: https://github.com/vaibhav-iitr/agent-os
Description: A working set of named AI agents (Donna, Captain, Sherlock, Alfred, Roy, Jarvis, Oracle) built on plain files, no infrastructure. Published May 2026.

Trust Debt — book in progress
Topic: How organisations accumulate structural trust failures through small, pragmatic decisions.
